title: Chris Enger shares how connected data can drive better decisions
summary: Clorox VP of Net Revenue Management Chris Enger shares how connecting data, analytics and cross-functional expertise helps teams make faster, more informed commercial decisions.
body_markdown:
In the consumer packaged goods industry, pricing, promotions, assortment and trade investments are increasingly interconnected. In a new[Consumer Goods Technology](https://consumergoods.com/next-gen-tpm-and-rgm-strategies-connected-commercial-enterprise?email-confirmed=true) Strategic Outlook Report, Clorox’s Chris Enger, vice president of net revenue management, shares how connecting data, analytics and cross-functional expertise has enabled our teams to make faster, more informed commercial decisions.


Commercial planning is the process of deciding how a company will sell its products and grow revenue. For consumer goods companies like Clorox, that includes decisions about:


- How to price products
- Which promotions to run
- What products and pack sizes to offer
- Where and how products are sold
- How much to invest with retailers
- How sales, marketing and finance coordinate those decisions


#### Here are a few takeaways from Chris on what a more connected approach can unlock:


##### Driving smarter pricing and promotion decisions


Better analytics are helping Clorox more quickly understand what’s driving consumer response, how competitors are reacting and which promotions are working, so teams can invest faster and more effectively.


##### Building a fuller view of demand


Connecting retailer, e-commerce, retail media and other marketplace signals can help distinguish true demand growth from shifts across retailers, channels and formats.


##### Using AI to augment decision-making


AI can help teams identify opportunities, explore scenarios and translate complex analysis into actionable recommendations, with trusted data and experienced people remaining essential.


##### Putting collaboration at the center


Ultimately, success depends on sales, marketing, finance, revenue growth management, analytics and IT working from shared metrics and clear decision rights, alongside the technology and analytics supporting them.
